newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Vienna stocks rebound, market seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Vienna stocks rebound, market seen steady.

text.p: Austrian shares crawled off earlier lows to end over one percent higher on Wednesday in technical rebound from yesterday's weakness and backed by the strong performance of German shares.
Traders said the market was boosted by a late flurry of buying, particularly in OMV and VA Tech, and that the improved performance of the two Creditanstalt issues also helped buoy the index.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips gained 12.5 points, or 1.22 percent, to 1,040.68 after earlier falling to 1,025.80. Of its constituents 18 advanced and three fell.
Traders generally expect the market to maintain its firm tone, but doubt the market is going anywhere soon.
"Market conditions are good, we should go higher -- but that's what we thought last Thursday," said one trader.
"It's important that we touch 1,050 points in order to confirm the upward trend," another trader said.
The day's best performing stock was Wolford, up 4.71 percent at 2,670 schillings, and the leading decliner was Boehler-Uddeholm, down 0.24 percent at 835.
Creditanstalt preferred shares gained 9.3 schillings to 456.3, while its ordinary shares advanced 11 schillings to 636.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index added on 0.74 percent to 404.58.
The October ATX future jumped 12 points to 1,045 on turnover of 999 contracts. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 274
